syn: Hitori no Shita: The Outcast 5th Season
Yi Ren Zhi Xia 5: Juezhan! Bi You Cun
一人之下5 决战！碧游村
d.synopsis: Zhang Chulan, Feng Baobao, and the temporary workers, in pursuit of Chen Duo, arrive at Biyou Village. While uncovering the truth behind Chen Duo's murder of Liao Zhong, the fate of Ma Xianhong and the cultivation furnace is also imminent. A dark and windy night, the perfect time for arson, a great battle is about to erupt! The decisive battle of Biyou Village is here!
